# DentalHQ (DentalHQ, LLC)

DentalHQ is a Software Development company. DentalHQ is a dental membership plan platform that offers customizable dental membership plans for insured and uninsured patients, increase patient loyalty, and ensure predictable revenue. DentalHQ employs 10 people, founded in 2017. Headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Zimbabwe. Has $2.6M in total funding, with 1 prior funding round.

## About

Introducing DentalHQ: the revolutionary in-house membership platform for dentists. Our platform empowers dentists to attract and retain fee-for-service patients while eliminating the hassles of dental insurance. With DentalHQ, you can provide uninsured patients with budgetary control over their dental care, reducing the #1 barrier to attracting uninsured patients: cost. 

Our platform, designed by a dentist, promotes overall patient health by removing barriers to oral healthcare and fosters a direct relationship between you and your patients. Our Saas application allows you to create custom dental membership plans, automate billing and reporting, and includes services to attract and retain new members. 

In addition to plan management, our platform offers patient financing tools, integrated marketing services, expert consultation, patient outreach, and new patient acquisition services, all designed to help you see more fee-for-service patients and increase practice revenue substantially. With a customer retention rate of 94.7%, our proven solutions have helped thousands of practitioners, DSOs, and dental professionals. Choose DentalHQ for the best value in in-house membership plan management.

# DentalHQ Joins the Inc 5000 List of America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies, Marking Their First Time on the List

## August 12, 2025

Raleigh, NC, August 12, 2025 -Inc., the leading media brand and playbook for the entrepreneurs and business leaders shaping our future, today announced that DentalHQ is one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, landing on their annual Inc. 5000 list. The list provides a data-driven snapshot of the most successful companies within the economy’s most dynamic segment—its independent, entrepreneurial businesses. Past honorees include Microsoft, Meta, Chobani, Under Armour, Timberland, Oracle, and Patagonia.

“This accomplishment is testament to a vision brought to life by our founder, Dr. Brett Wells, and the dedication, hard work, and unwavering commitment of our incredible team,” said Kendra Hunter, COO of DentalHQ.Founded in 2017, DentalHQ provides industry-leading membership plan software designed to help dental practices reduce insurance dependency, retain more patients, and create predictable recurring revenue. The platform offers plans for every patient, seamless PMS integration, guaranteed plan payments, and marketing tools like BusinessCONNECT and CommunityCONNECT—making it the most responsive, intuitive, and connected membership solution on the market.Today, DentalHQ serves practices nationwide, from solo offices to DSOs and multi-location groups, helping them increase patient loyalty, boost treatment acceptance, and automate administrative tasks so teams can focus on care, not paperwork. See DentalHQ in action today!“Making the Inc. 5000 is always a remarkable achievement, but earning a spot this year speaks volumes about a company’s tenacity and clarity of vision,” says Mike Hofman, editor-in-chief of Inc. “These businesses didn’t just weather the storm—they grew through it, and their stories are a powerful reminder that the entrepreneurial spirit is the engine of the U.S. economy.”

For the full list, company profiles, and a searchable database by industry and location, visit: www.inc.com/inc5000.Inc. will celebrate the honorees at the 2025 Inc. 5000 Conference & Gala, taking place October 22-24 in Phoenix, and the top 500 will be listed in the fall issue of Inc. magazine.About DentalHQ

Through features like plans for every patient, seamless PMS integration, guaranteed plan payments, team incentives, and marketing tools like BusinessCONNECT and CommunityCONNECT, DentalHQ makes membership plans easy for teams and valuable for patients. results.title: About DentalHQ | Revolutionizing Dental Membership Plans
results.text:
DentalHQ | Dental Membership Plan Platform

## Whether you're a solo practice or a growing DSO, DentalHQ makes creating custom dental membership plans for every patient simple, profitable, and automated. 

## What is Dental Membership Plan Software?

Dental membership plan software is a platform that enables dental practices to create, automate, manage, and scale in-house membership plans. It replaces spreadsheets, manual billing, disconnected payment systems, and binder-based tracking with automated recurring billing, enrollment tools, reporting dashboards, and direct integration with practice management systems (also known as PMS). In practical terms, it transforms membership plans from a manual program into an operational infrastructure. Instead of relying entirely on insurance reimbursements, practices use membership software to: 

- Generate predictable recurring revenue
- Increase patient retention
- Improve preventive compliance
- Reduce administrative overhead
- Gain financial visibility

 A membership plan without software can function temporarily. A membership strategy built on software can scale. 

Going out of network opens up your time and resources (bonus: happy team members!) for something that can end up pulling in far more patients than you ever have before - more than enough to make up for the loss. We’re talking about dental membership plans. 

## What if you could drop a PPO and keep your patients coming back?

## Why Do Dentists Choose DentalHQ?

Not all membership plan platforms are created equal. DentalHQ is built with practices in mind - so it’s easy for your team, trusted by your patients, and ready to grow with you. 

- Responsive: Industry-best support with real people who understand dentistry
- Intuitive: Clean, easy-to-use platform your team will actually enjoy using
- Connected: PMS integration and patient engagement tools that keep everything in sync.

Not every patient is the same - and their dental membership options shouldn’t be either. With DentalHQ, you can design plans for every patient, to meet their needs, from preventative care to cosmetic services. 

## Real Results, Real Growth

DentalHQ isn’t just software - it’s a growth engine for your practice. 

- +37% average annual membership revenue growth
- 95%+ renewals handled automatically
- Trusted by 1,000+ practices nationwide
